note: Rustic state forest campground on the east shore of Sullivan Lake in Finland State Forest, beside the public landing, with nature trails and four day-use picnic sites. The DNR reports the lake very low and the boat launch unusable, probably for the long term (May 1, 2026). --Claude
summary: DNR record, map and fees page read: 11 primitive drive-in sites, vault toilets, drinking water, $17 same-day pay (tax included), first come; boat launch closed for low water (2026-05-01). Leaf-off imagery shows the sites along the shore road behind a conifer fringe: lakefront -> lakeview proposed. Pin ~280 m off (move proposed). Website to hyphen form; phone added; note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed; default down): the DNR map has no site numbers and there are no campsite photos. On the 2024 leaf-off Lake County imagery (MnGeo lake24) the campground road runs along the east shore and its spurs end about 15-30 m from the water (e.g. about 47.3790,-91.6703 and 47.3786,-91.6705), but a continuous fringe of spruce/cedar lines the shore in front of them; no pad shows on open ground to the water. Esri imagery is clouded over the campground. The record also says the lake is 'very low', so the waterline has receded from the pads. Under the default-down rule this is a view, not lakefront.

STATUS (not a closure): 'Boat launch is closed. Sullivan Lake's water level is very low, and the boat launch is not currently usable. We expect this will likely be a long-term situation. (May 1, 2026)'. Put in the note; the campground itself is open.

PIN 47.3814,-91.6685 is ~280 m NNE of the campground, north of the site road. The leaf-off imagery puts the shore road and site spurs between about 47.3782 and 47.3803, centre about 47.3792,-91.6703 (the DNR facility point 47.378173,-91.67058 is at the south end, by the landing). Move to 47.3792,-91.6703.
